runtimeArgs: const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const dir='C:/projects/tangobook/lottie-samples';const types={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{let u=req.url.split('?')[0];if(u==='/')u='/index.html';const f=path.join(dir,u);fs.readFile(f,(e,c)=>{if(e){res.writeHead(404);res.end('not found')}else{res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':types[path.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});res.end(c)}})}).listen(8137,'127.0.0.1',()=>console.log('Lottie preview running on http://localhost:8137'))
